configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: A focused Debug build for editing CNA itself. It omits tests, examples, the C API, networking, FFmpeg, and Draco; use the unit or an integration preset before merging.

configurePresets.name: unit
configurePresets.description: Builds CnaTests without demos, the C API, networking, FFmpeg, or Draco. Use the renderer-specific and integration presets for coverage that requires those components.

configurePresets.name: release-modules
configurePresets.description: A portable Release configuration for checking optimized CNA module and content-tool builds without test/demo/C API volume.

configurePresets.name: release-ipo
configurePresets.description: Opt-in IPO/LTO measurement configuration. It is deliberately separate because LTO improves some final artifacts at the cost of compile/link time.

configurePresets.name: web
configurePresets.description: Builds house3d_demo as a self-contained HTML page via Emscripten. Requires EMSDK to be active (source emsdk_env.sh). Run with: emcmake cmake --preset web

configurePresets.name: devices-asan
configurePresets.description: Debug + OPENGLES3 + tests, instrumented with AddressSanitizer. Verified working in plans/plan_devices_phase8.md Task P8-4 — detects use-after-free/heap-corruption bugs (e.g. the Task P8-1 self-destroy-during-callback fix). Does not detect data races; use devices-tsan for that. REMED-BUILD-011: CNA_DEVICES=ON is required here — without it, the entire CNA::Devices surface (FileDialog/MessageBox/Clipboard/SystemTray/...) this preset's own name and description promise compiles out silently.

configurePresets.name: devices-tsan
configurePresets.description: Debug + OPENGLES3 + tests, instrumented with ThreadSanitizer. Verified working in plans/plan_devices_phase8.md Task P8-4 — the tool that actually detects data races (ASan does not). As of Task P8-2, running the Devices-only test suite under this preset reports exactly one pre-existing, unrelated race in sharp-runtime's TimeSpan copy constructor (a debug copy_count counter) — out of scope for Microsoft::Devices work; any *new* race reported here is worth investigating. REMED-BUILD-011: CNA_DEVICES=ON is required here — without it, the entire CNA::Devices surface (FileDialog/MessageBox/Clipboard/SystemTray/...) this preset's own name and description promise compiles out silently.

configurePresets.name: devices-ubsan
configurePresets.description: Debug + OPENGLES3 + tests, instrumented with UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer. Verified working in plans/plan_devices_phase8.md Task P8-4 — the full Devices-only suite reports zero issues under this preset. REMED-BUILD-011: CNA_DEVICES=ON is required here — without it, the entire CNA::Devices surface (FileDialog/MessageBox/Clipboard/SystemTray/...) this preset's own name and description promise compiles out silently.

configurePresets.name: macos
configurePresets.description: plans/plan_apple.md APPLE-1: native macOS desktop build. Requires the sibling sharp-runtime checkout and initialized submodules; the first configure builds SDL3/SDL3_image/SDL3_mixer into .sdl-prebuilt-Darwin-<arch>/ (several minutes) and every later configure reuses it. The deployment target defaults to CNA_MACOS_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET (13.3); executables stay plain binaries unless CNA_APPLE_BUNDLE_MACOS_EXECUTABLES=ON. For the native Metal renderer use -DCNA_GRAPHICS_RENDERER=METAL instead, and read docs/metal-renderer.md first.

configurePresets.name: ios
configurePresets.displayName: iOS device (arm64, SDL_RENDERER, final-link smoke app)
configurePresets.description: plans/plan_apple.md APPLE-2/APPLE-13: cross-compiles CNA and final-links cna_ios_smoke.app for arm64 iPhone/iPad on a macOS host with Xcode. Tests/examples are off because their harnesses assume a desktop process/filesystem. The app is not run on a physical device; see docs/apple-platforms.md. Add -G Xcode and -DCNA_APPLE_DEVELOPMENT_TEAM=<TEAMID> to sign and deploy.

configurePresets.name: ios-simulator
configurePresets.displayName: iOS simulator (host arch, SDL_RENDERER, smoke app)
configurePresets.description: plans/plan_apple.md APPLE-2/APPLE-13: the simulator counterpart of the 'ios' preset. It final-links cna_ios_smoke.app; Apple CI installs and launches that app for one framework frame. Kept in its own build directory because device and simulator binaries are not interchangeable even at the same architecture, which is also why the vendored SDL install root is keyed by sysroot.

configurePresets.name: tests
configurePresets.displayName: Native desktop tests (OpenGL ES renderer, Debug)
configurePresets.description: P9-BUILD-002: native (non-Emscripten) debug build with CNA_BUILD_TESTS/CNA_BUILD_EXAMPLES on, for running CnaTests (including all Audio suites) locally. Requires 'git submodule update --init --recursive' first (third_party/SDL, third_party/SDL_image, third_party/SDL_mixer, vendor/googletest) -- see NEXTaudio.md §7 / plans/plan_audio.md Phase 9 P9-BUILD for the full dependency story. First configure builds SDL3/SDL3_image/SDL3_mixer from source into .sdl-prebuilt/ (several minutes); every later configure/build reuses that cache. Run: cmake --preset tests && cmake --build --preset tests --target CnaTests && SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy ./cmake-build-tests/CnaTests -- running the CnaTests binary directly (not `ctest`) is the authoritative way to run the suite: `ctest` discovers and runs each gtest case as its own short-lived process, which both spuriously reports every unbuilt display-dependent graphics smoke-test executable as failed and races several tests that share hardcoded /tmp fixture paths across processes -- neither is a real bug in the tests themselves, see plans/plan_audio.md P9-BUILD-007.

configurePresets.name: multi-renderer
configurePresets.description: plans/plan_runtimerenderer.md reference multi-renderer set: no window, no GPU dependency, no third-party closure, so it runs anywhere including CI with no display server. The renderer is chosen at runtime via CNA::GraphicsRendererSelection.

configurePresets.name: cnaext
configurePresets.displayName: CNAEXT engine layer (OpenGL ES renderer, Debug)
configurePresets.description: plans/plan_modern.md MOD-2: native debug build with the CNA::Graphics extended engine layer enabled (CNA_CNAEXT=ON) plus tests -- the build every plans/plan_modern.md task is verified in. Without CNA_CNAEXT the whole CNA::Graphics layer (RenderPipelineSettings, PbrMaterial, DepthEffect, CRTEffect, AsciiPostProcessEffect, and everything plans/plan_modern.md adds on top) compiles to nothing, so the default build cannot verify it. Same submodule/SDL prerequisites as the 'tests' preset above. Run: cmake --preset cnaext && cmake --build --preset cnaext --target CnaTests && SDL_AUDIODRIVER=dummy ./cmake-build-cnaext/CnaTests --gtest_filter='CnaExt*:DepthEffect*:CRTEffect*:AsciiPostProcess*'
